Definition: Tola, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Two Israelites are named Tola. One is the son of Issachar, listed among his brothers in Genesis and Chronicles, and the other is Tola the son of Puah, who judged Israel after Abimelech.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lists must be read slowly: the son of Issachar and the judge of Puah share a name and a tribe, and the Bible keeps them distinct.
